verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart documents a `custom_vocabulary_config` request parameter that takes a list of domain terms and names (e.g. "Gladia", "Solaria", "Salesforce"). That is a first-party custom vocabulary capability that directly matches the story. The separate custom spelling feature only normalizes spelling variants, so it is adjacent and adds no credit. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of boosting strength, limits, or phonetic hints; evidence that custom vocabulary works in live/real-time sessions; independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy gains.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly
